scope: Durable authenticated asynchronous research; bounded retrieval and server-bound extractive summary

service_independent_checks.skip_reason: Real PostgreSQL/Redis/worker/container tests disabled in this separate check; executed in full real-dependency run

tests.warning: Existing Starlette/httpx TestClient deprecation; no dependency added to hide it

development_experiment.initial_quote_reconstruction: Actual model removed PDF references/hyphenation and binding correctly refused it
development_experiment.decision: Use numbered original-text selection; server retrieves original excerpt; no prompt or budget expansion

test_distinctions.deterministic: Policy, schema, context estimator, safe errors and controlled model substitutes
test_distinctions.real_database: Transactions, constraints, ownership, races, snapshots and commit fault injection against actual PostgreSQL
test_distinctions.real_queue: Actual Redis and spawned worker; loopback HTTP inference substitute for deterministic retry, invalid-output, cancellation and SIGKILL tests
test_distinctions.real_model: Pinned Ollama weights, locked PDF and real HTTP/worker flow for one dev case plus two no-inference refusals

review.correctness: Canonical request/hash, owner-scoped idempotency, execution lease, original-text binding and atomic publication
review.error_handling: Queue uncertainty, reservation failure, deadline, cancellation, crash, late execution and uncertain COMMIT
review.tests: Success, edge and failure checks; real dependencies and real inference distinguished
review.security: Owner checks in queries and service, fixed functions/JSON, bounded input, no raw provider error or secret exposure
review.maintainability: Scenario policy injected into shared task service, no new dependency

remaining_limits: Single development case is not corpus-wide retrieval or answer-quality evaluation
Methods-only keyword guard can miss or over-refuse; not a complete medical safety classifier
Extractive source membership does not prove relevance, completeness or absence of conflicting evidence
Simple punctuation segmentation can group adjacent sentences or split abbreviations; unfinished fragments are refused
Context estimator is byte-based heuristic; no exact tokenizer guarantee
Synchronous SQL/cooperative deadlines are not hard real-time or hostile-input isolation
Cancellation does not prove inference stopped server-side; digest inventory is not atomic response provenance
No public retry or trace, automatic complete-ingestion scheduling, periodic recovery, production deployment or full-corpus seed
Developer source/label review, third genuine conflict and independent oral review remain pending
git_delivery: Evidence is written before commit/push. Final Git history and chat identify commit, remote push and CI status.
